plugin.name: Workspace_Integration_Fixture
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Offline loopback workspace pipeline assertions; no user worlds

muclient.script:
local path=GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(),6) local receipt=path..'.receipt.txt' local control=path..'.control.txt' local enabled=false local received,triggers={},{} local function record(message) local f=assert(io.open(receipt,'a'));f:write(message,'
');f:close() end local function check(condition,label) record((condition and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ')..label) end function OnPluginInstall() if WorldName()~='Workspace isolated integration' or GetAlphaOption('site')~='127.0.0.1' then return end enabled=true local f=assert(io.open(receipt,'w'));f:write('PLUGIN_PATH '..path..'
');f:close() local ok,err=pcall(function() assert(AddTriggerEx('pipeline_count','^WS_.*$','',41,-1,0,'','CountTrigger',12,100)==0) record('READY plugin initialized') end) if not ok then record('ERROR '..tostring(err)) end end function CountTrigger(name,line,wildcards) local key=line:match('^(WS_[A-Z]+)') triggers[key]=(triggers[key] or 0)+1 if key=='WS_REENTRANT' then Note('LOCAL_REENTRANT_NOTE') end if key=='WS_TRIMOMIT' then Note('LOCAL_TRIM_NOTE') end end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if not enabled then return true end if line:match('^%x+ JlRFU1QgIzE9RklYVFVSRV9QUklWQVRFX0NPREVfT1dORURfUkVQTFk=$') then record('PRIVATE_REPLY_PLUGIN_OMITTED');return false end local key=line:match('^(WS_[A-Z]+)') if key then received[key]=(received[key] or 0)+1 end if key=='WS_PARENT' then Simulate('WS_CHILD omitted nested
') end if key=='WS_CHILD' then return false end if key=='WS_CLEARVIA' then DeleteOutput();Note('AFTER_CALLBACK_CLEAR');return true end if key=='WS_OMIT' or key=='WS_TRIMOMIT' then return false end return true end function OnPluginTick() if not enabled then return end local f=io.open(control,'r');if not f then return end local command=f:read('*a');f:close();os.remove(control) local ok,err=pcall(function() if command=='assert' then for _,key in ipairs({'WS_NORMAL','WS_WRAP','WS_REENTRANT','WS_OMIT'}) do check(received[key]==1,key..' plugin exactly once: '..tostring(received[key])) check(triggers[key]==1,key..' trigger exactly once: '..tostring(triggers[key])) end local omitted,notes=0,0 for i=1,GetLinesInBufferCount() do local text=GetLineInfo(i,1) if text:find('WS_OMIT',1,true) then omitted=omitted+1 end if text:find('LOCAL_REENTRANT_NOTE',1,true) then notes=notes+1 end end check(omitted==0,'plugin omitted line absent from native output') check(notes==1,'reentrant trigger note appears once') record('ASSERT COMPLETE') elseif command=='trim' then local maximum=GetOption('max_output_lines')-1 for i=1,maximum do if GetLinesInBufferCount()>=maximum then break end Simulate('FILL_'..i..'
') end record('TRIM BEFORE '..GetLinesInBufferCount()) Simulate('WS_TRIMOMIT private pending
') local leaked=0 for i=1,GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(i,1):find('WS_TRIMOMIT',1,true) then leaked=leaked+1 end end check(leaked==0,'trim reentrant omitted line absent from original buffer') record('TRIM COMPLETE '..GetLinesInBufferCount()) elseif command=='delete' then Simulate('DELETE_ME visible tail
') DeleteLines(1) record('DELETE COMPLETE') elseif command=='pane' then for i=1,2100 do Simulate('PANE_ROUTE_'..i..'
') end record('PANE COMPLETE') elseif command=='nested' then Simulate('WS_PARENT visible outer
') local parent,child=0,0 for i=1,GetLinesInBufferCount() do local text=GetLineInfo(i,1) if text:find('WS_PARENT',1,true) then parent=parent+1 end if text:find('WS_CHILD',1,true) then child=child+1 end end record('NESTED_RESULT parentrows='..parent..' childrows='..child..' parentcallbacks='..tostring(received.WS_PARENT)..' childcallbacks='..tostring(received.WS_CHILD)) elseif command=='callbackclear' then Simulate('WS_CLEARVIA deleted callback source
') local leaked=0 for i=1,GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(i,1):find('WS_CLEARVIA',1,true) then leaked=leaked+1 end end check(leaked==0,'clear inside callback does not resurrect source') record('CALLBACK CLEAR COMPLETE') elseif command=='clear' then DeleteOutput();record('CLEAR COMPLETE') elseif command=='disconnect' then Disconnect();record('DISCONNECT COMPLETE') elseif command=='close' then Close();record('CLOSE REQUESTED') else record('ERROR unknown fixture control') end end) if not ok then record('ERROR '..tostring(err)) end end
